canonical_title: Devices for warning of or preventing dangerous conditions

versions.title_at_revision: Devices for warning of or preventing dangerous conditions
versions.text:
Standard: Special devices incorporated to eliminate dangerous flight conditions perform their functions whenever needed and do not limit flight within the ROSH. Normal or inadvertent operation of such devices does not create a hazard to the air vehicle. There is no nuisance operation of these devices. Functional failure of these devices are indicated to the pilot. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the operations of special devices incorporated to eliminate dangerous flight conditions are not hazardous to the air vehicle for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the operations of special devices incorporated to eliminate dangerous flight conditions are not hazardous to the air vehicle for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
